Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States

Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 300,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. This turns out to be a pretty wild endeavor, so we’re looking to bring someone smart onto our Customer Support team to help us out.

As a member of our Customer Support team, you’ll make sure our users are charmed by warmth and competence when they have questions or needs that aren’t being met by our product. You’ll radiate intelligence while exercising your best human qualities, like compassion and empathy, even in the face of frustration. 

You’ll need to understand how our product works in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What You’ll Do: 

• Answer user questions over chat, email, and phone

• Handle user account requests, including application processing, card disputes, missing payments, card shipments, and a whole lot more

• Teach customers how to use our product (hopefully most of it is self-explanatory), and translate user confusion into product suggestions

• Identify the systemic flaws that lead to user problems

• Work with our engineering team to find and squash bugs

• Communicate our users' needs to our partner banks and work with them to improve their products and processes

• Write help articles and FAQs

• Learn our internal tools and figure out how to improve them

• Put in place processes to make your job more efficient

• Help with other compliance and customer tasks

• Create and sustain warm relationships with our users

• Help build out the customer support and ops infrastructure at Mercury

What You Bring:

• Have 2+ years of experience in a Customer Experience / Customer Support role

• Consistently exercise empathy

• Always seek to answer the question behind the question

• Understand how to translate complex terminology into clear, human user communication

• Enjoy thinking about how to automate as much of your job as possible

• Keep a clean, ordered inbox

• Stay calm and collected while working on ten things at once

• Feel confident talking with startup folks in person, over chat, or on the phone

• Use creativity while working within difficult constraints

• Show kindness in the face of unpleasantness (our customers generally are really great, but they can get passionate when it comes to their businesses)

Would be nice if you: 

• Have experience working in retail branch banking 

• Are passionate about uncovering customer needs 

• Enjoy solving customer problems and proactively offering solutions to unmet needs

Schedule Information:

• Required: be available to work at least one weekend day per 5 day shift 

• We are currently hiring for multiple shifts. Openings will be covered early in the interview process

• Your working schedule will be fixed - this is long-term commitment, not a rotating shift

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - and behind every high-performing leader is someone who makes sure nothing slips. This is a high-trust, hands-on role for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, holds themselves to a high standard, and takes genuine pride in making their lead's life easier - down to the small, considered details that others overlook.
You'll be the operational backbone for senior leadership - managing calendars, coordinating across time zones, handling logistics, and owning the day-to-day administrative tasks that let leadership focus on what matters most.

In this role, you will:
• 
Manage complex, fast-moving calendars and provide scheduling and coordination support across multiple time zones and geographies
• 
Handle sensitive and confidential matters with discretion, acting as a trusted partner in both professional and operational contexts
• 
Coordinate seamlessly with internal stakeholders across teams, as well as external partners and senior leaders
• 
Work closely with other EAs across the organisation to align schedules, share context, and keep cross-functional coordination running smoothly
• 
Anticipate needs before they arise: managing follow-ups, flagging conflicts, and keeping the right people aligned
• 
Build structure, processes, and systems that scale with a fast-growing AI company
• 
Identify opportunities to automate and streamline repetitive work, using AI tools and productivity tooling to improve quality and speed

Requirements
• 
Proven experience supporting senior leaders and their broader teams in a fast-moving environment, including coordinating with other EAs across the organisation
• 
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities, shifting timelines, and multiple stakeholders
• 
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from senior executives and partners to vendors and office guests
• 
High emotional intelligence and discretion - trusted with sensitive information
• 
Comfortable supporting not just an individual but a wider team at times - able to flex between high-priority senior leadership support and broader operational needs as the situation demands
• 
Personable and easy to work with - someone who builds genuine relationships across the organisation and is trusted by the people around them
• 
A natural reflex to reach for tooling and automation; fluency with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT and quick to adopt new systems
• 
High personal standards - the kind of person who cares about the quality of their output and holds the bar
• 
A valid passport and willingness to travel globally ~40% of the time

India or Dubai

About the Role

The Senior AI Evals Test Engineer  is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment — ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement. The engineer will design scalable evaluation pipelines, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is 70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing, and sits within the Applied AI: Test Engineering team as a key technical authority.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build agent evaluation frameworks — create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
  • Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models)
  • Build golden datasets and test harnesses — curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
  • Establish eval-as-a-service — build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
  • Automate regression and drift detection — implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
  • Define eval taxonomies and rubrics — establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
  • Instrument production observability — build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
  • Benchmark and select models — run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
  • Analyze and interpret evaluation results, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
  • Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies — functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) — tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
  • Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
  • Evaluate new technologies and patterns (e.g., new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
  • Partner with policy and legal teams to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
  • Provide technical leadership to engineers, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
  • Collaborate cross-functionally — work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • 2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
  • 2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy, quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
  • 1+ years in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

Technical Skills

  • Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval,LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
  • Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns — tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
  • Production experience with eval pipelines — building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
  • Proficiency in Python — strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
  • Statistical literacy — ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
  • Enterprise product sensibility — understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
  • Excellent communication — ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

Tech Stack:

  • Languages: Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
  • Test Automation:Selenium, Playwright
  • LLM Providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models
  • Eval Tooling: DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ …

Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote, US

Descript's Research team builds the models behind the product's most distinctive features: Video Regenerate and lipsync, video translation, zero-shot voice and roomtone cloning, and Studio Sound. We don't build general-purpose generative models. We pick specific problems in the editing workflow and build specialized models for them. This isn't research for its own sake. Everything we build is meant to ship, and most of it has, going from prototype to a production feature used by millions of creators within months.

This role is focused on multimodal understanding: training models to perceive edited media the way a human video editor does. Underlord, our AI editing agent, reasons about a project largely through a textual representation of it. Giving it direct perception of the media it's working on is what will let it judge its own output and reason about the creative choices in an edit, not just the structure of a project. It's also an open research problem, since there's no settled way to represent or evaluate editorial craft, whether a cut lands or whether the pacing works. We have a unique dataset to work with.

Some recent work from the team:

• Audio editing by latent inpainting: regenerating a masked span of speech 

• Video Regenerate: regenerating a speaker's lower face to match new or translated audio

• Jumpcut Smoothing: generating a bridge across a cut so the join plays like a continuous take

• Anchored Tree Sampling: tree-based imputation that bounds drift in long video generation

• PoDAR: disentangling power from semantics in audio latents to make them easier to model

More at descript.com/research.

What you'll do

• Multimodal understanding: build vision-language systems that let Descript's agentic editing features reason over the visual and audio content of a project.

• Evaluation: design the benchmarks and evals that make editorial quality measurable, and that balance quality against cost and latency.

• Data: build the datasets your work depends on, including synthetic data generation where real examples don't exist at scale.

• Training: train specialized models from scratch or fine-tune existing foundation models, whichever gets the capability we need.

• Shipping: take models from prototype to production with the agent and engineering teams.

• Direction-setting: identify the next research direction that should become a Descript feature, not just a paper. More senior candidates should expect to own this directly; more junior candidates will grow into it.

• Publishing: take your work to academic venues if you'd like. We support it, but it isn't a requirement of the role.

What you bring

Required

• Proven ability to design and implement deep learning algorithms, demonstrated by publications, open-source work, or models you've shipped.

• Strong programming skills and deep fluency in PyTorch.

• A track record of generating new ideas in machine learning. You produce more ideas than you can implement, and once an experiment setup is established, you can run and evaluate many of them quickly rather than being bottlenecked on infrastructure.

• Strong experimental judgment. You test ideas fast, and you're honest with yourself and the team about which ones don't pan out.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including when a direction isn't working, so the team doesn't waste time following a lead that's already dead.

• A PhD or Master's in deep learning or a related field, or equivalent experience. We care about the track record more than the credential.

At least one of the following must be true:

• Lead or first author of an accepted publication in a top venue: CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or similar.

• Played a key role in shipping a production feature with deep learning as a core component.

More senior candidates (Senior and Staff) should also bring a track record of owning research direction rather than executing a plan handed to them, and experience mentoring or technically leading other researchers or engineers.

Where breadth helps

Direct experience in multimodal understanding is welcome but not required, and we don't require domain-specific expertise in computer vision or speech and audio. Our team spans both, and strong general deep learning ability transfers. We hire against the bar above, and then expect you to grow into the domain. Depth in any of these is a strong signal:

• Vision-language models and multimodal understanding.

• Generative modeling for video, audio, or images.

• Post-training, fine-tuning, and RL on large foundation models.

• Building evaluation systems for generative or agentic outputs where metrics resist clean definitions.

• Taking a research idea through to a shipped, production-facing feature.

Compensation and benefits

Base salary range: $197,000–$262,500, plus equity and benefits. Final offer amounts will carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location, and level, and may vary from the amount above.

Headquarters: San Diego, CA, USA
 
URL: http://www.shoutaboutus.com

Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships

Shout About Us · Remote (worldwide) · Full-time · 60K - 80K USD

About the role

We're hiring a Technical Account Manager to own and grow our most strategic accounts. You’ll own the technical relationship with our API partners, from their first technical evaluation through implementation and ongoing support.

Reporting directly to the CRO, you’ll be the first dedicated post-sales professional at Shout About Us, responsible for making sure our biggest customers deploy, expand, and stay. Our ICP is founders, product teams, and engineering teams. 

This is a hands-on role. On any given day, you might join a prospect’s technical discovery call, troubleshoot an API request with a partner engineer, coordinate a fix with our engineering team, or improve a quickstart guide. You’ll also help build the documentation and processes that make each new integration easier than the last.

Location and hours

Remote, anywhere. Our standard working hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. US Eastern Time, including a lunch break. Occasional calls outside these hours are required for APAC partners and key implementation milestones.

What you’ll do

• 

Own a portfolio of 10-15 strategic accounts. Be the primary technical contact for API partners, keep stakeholders informed, and follow issues through to resolution.

• 

Support technical evaluations. Join sales calls, demonstrate API capabilities, understand the partner’s requirements, and explain how an integration would work.

• 

Lead partner implementations. Turn requirements into a clear integration plan, guide developers through setup and testing, and track progress through launch.

• 

Troubleshoot directly. Investigate requests, responses, logs, authentication issues, and integration behavior before escalating to engineering.

• 

Work closely with engineering. Provide clear reproduction steps, relevant evidence, and customer impact when an issue needs deeper investigation.

• 

Improve the developer experience. Create and maintain API guides, Postman collections, code examples, FAQs, and onboarding playbooks.

• 

Identify recurring friction. Share partner feedback and integration patterns that can inform product improvements.

• 

Lead expansion efforts. Cross-sell new features and products as a natural extension of the relationship, not a separate motion. 

What we’re looking for

• 

4+ years in a customer-facing technical role or equivalent at an API-first or dev-tools company

• 

Strong practical understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, authentication, webhooks, pagination, and rate limits.

• 

Comfort using Postman or curl, reading logs, and writing or adapting small code examples in a language such as JavaScript or Python.

• 

Experience driving adoption inside complex orgs: navigating the gap between the buyer who signed and the team that deploys

• 

Strong follow-through. You keep track of open questions, set expectations, and make sure customers know what happens next.

• 

Startup experience at a company under 50 people. There's no support team behind you.

• 

Clear written and spoken English. You can explain the same issue to a developer and a nontechnical stakeholder.

• 

Owner mentality. "I'll make sure this gets done," not "I passed it to engineering."

Why you should join

• 

Own meaningful partner relationships from technical evaluation through launch and beyond.

• 

See the impact of your work in successful integrations and better customer experiences.

• 

You’ll own and drive every initiative you work on from start to finish. We fully trust you.

• 

Work remotely from anywhere while collaborating on a shared schedule.

• 

Work directly with the people selling and building the product.

Why you shouldn't join

• 

You are not comfortable working without a clear structure and playbook. 

• 

You need predictable hours. Most weeks are normal. Go-live weeks and APAC escalations aren't.

Interview process

Our process includes an introductory call, a short written exercise, a practical technical session, and a final conversation with our CEO. We’ll share the details and expected time commitment before each step.

About Shout About Us

Shout About Us is API-first review infrastructure for marketplaces and platforms.

Reviews are the most valuable decision signal in every transaction: which agent, which contractor, which property, which restaurant. Almost every platform that hosts those decisions rents that signal from Google, Trustpilot or Yelp. We give platforms the APIs and infrastructure to own it.

What you can build with our APIs:

• 

A verified first-party review engine: collection, verification, moderation and publishing under your brand

• 

Third-party review aggregation from Google, Yelp, Facebook and 80+ other sources

• 

AI review responses drafted and posted natively, without your customers leaving your platform

• 

Review solicitation and surveys triggered from events in your product

• 

Flagging, disputes, AI insight reports and competitor analysis

We’re a small team looking for someone who can make it easier for partners to understand, integrate, and succeed with our API.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/shout-about-us-technical-account-manager-api-partnerships
